title: Horizon Reborn
description: Version 1.21.1 | A Proper Vanilla++ Modpack | Don't play Vanilla, play this!
body: ![Modpack Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b9d73d01201ab5709b6e43a3f1baff48edcd50d.png) Horizon Reborn is a 1.21.1 Fabric overhaul designed for players who want more than just "Vanilla+." Developed by ClockSpeed Studios, I’ve combined technology, combat, and breathtaking world generation into a single, high-performance package. For the intended "Horizon" look, we highly recommend downloading these additions: Bliss Shaders (Atmospheric Lighting) Fresh Animations (Fluid Mob Movement) AVPBR Retextured (High-End Textures) Fresh Moves (Animated Player Eyes/Moves) ✔️ Full Fabric Parity: Maximum performance and compatibility. ✔️ 100+ Quests: A guided experience through your new world. ✔️ Dungeon Crawling: Hundreds of structures via When Dungeons Arise & AdoraBuild. ✔️ World Gen: Completely overhauled terrain with Terralith and Distant Horizons. ✔️ High-End Optimization: Built-in shader support and FPS stabilization. ✔️ New Challenges: Fight Bosses of Mass Destruction and survive Frostiful mechanics. ✔️ Home Decor: 1000+ furniture items to customize your base. ![Modpack Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a086fb25d0e4eb57d4991595bb0eb0df94910a5d.png) 💻 Tested Performance Optimized for high-end setups. Tested on RTX 4060 Ti (16GB) & Ryzen 7 7800X3D: Render Distance: 32 Chunks Simulation Distance: 32 Chunks Performance: Stable 50–60 FPS with Bliss/Kappa Shaders & Resource Packs enabled. ![Modpack Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a086fb25d0e4eb57d4991595bb0eb0df94910a5d.png) 🤝 Support & Community If you enjoy the performance and detail of Horizon Reborn, consider supporting my journey as a young developer!
